summary.title: Flutter Firebase Backend Course for Beginners - Zoom Clone | Video Conferencing App
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a Zoom-style video conferencing app in Flutter using Firebase Google Sign-In for auth and Jitsi Meet for the video calls.
takeaways: Set up Flutter with Firebase and configure Google Sign-In for both iOS and Android.
Persist login state so users stay signed in across app launches.
Integrate Jitsi Meet to create and join video meetings with mute/unmute controls.
Store a user's meeting history in Firebase and display it on the home screen.
summary.summary: This is a chaptered YouTube video course (about 2 hours 13 minutes of content) by Rivaan Ranawat that builds a Zoom clone in Flutter. It walks through Flutter setup, a login screen, Firebase setup with Google Sign-In for iOS and Android, and persisting user state. The home screen, Jitsi Meet setup for iOS, creating and joining meetings, and storing and displaying a user's meetings in Firebase are then covered, followed by logout, testing on devices, and a pros and cons section. The listing does not give a difficulty level beyond the title's 'for beginners'.
